item.title: 使用faye + sidekiq制作实时消息队列

item.title: 实现网打算换成puma来跑
item.description: 将unicorn换成puma的原因： 节省内存 ，提高效率 Capistrano部署集成（capistrano3-puma） 以下为手动配置方法： 启动puma text Copy 1bundle exec puma -b unix:///tmp/puma.sock -e production --daemon nginx配置例子： ​ text Copy 1upstream shixian { 2 server unix:///tmp/puma.sock; 3} 4 5server { 6 listen 80; 7 server_name dev.shixian.com; 8 9 # ~2 seconds is often enough for most folks to parse HTML/CSS and 10 # retrieve needed images/icons/frames, connections are cheap in 11 # nginx so increasing this is generally safe... 12 keepalive_timeout 5; 13 14 # path for static files 15 root /home/deploy/apps/shixian/public; 16 access_log /home/deploy/apps/shixian/log/nginx.

item.title: 使用Houston+Sidekiq做ios消息推送
item.description: 创建NotifierWorker类 ruby Copy 1# app/workers/notifier_worker.rb 2require 'apn_connection' 3class NotifierWorker 4 include Sidekiq::Worker 5 6 APN_POOL = ConnectionPool.new(:size => 2, :timeout => 300) do 7 APNConnection.new 8 end 9​ 10 def perform(message, custom_data = nil) 11 APN_POOL.with do |connection| 12 token = "<dccec3dd 25936d87 5ed2d16b 75f0785c bdb0b33d 8dd48f1c 72529c00 b1c56a19>" 13 notification = Houston::Notification.new(device: token) 14 notification.alert = message 15 notification.sound = 'default' 16 notification.custom_data = custom_data 17 connection.write(notification.message) 18 end 19 end 20end 创建APNConnection类

item.title: 在Rails中实现markdown解析
item.description: 首先，安装gem text Copy 1gem 'redcarpet' 然后在app/helpers/application_helper.rb添加如下代码： text Copy 1def markdown(text) 2 render_options = { 3 filter_html: false, 4 hard_wrap: true, 5 link_attributes: { rel: 'nofollow' } 6 } 7 renderer = Redcarpet::Render::HTML.new(render_options) 8 extensions = { 9 #will parse links without need of enclosing them 10 autolink: true, 11 fenced_code_blocks: true, 12 # will ignore standard require for empty lines surrounding HTML blocks 13 lax_spacing: true, 14 # will not generate emphasis inside of words, for example no_emph_no 15 no_intra_emphasis: true, 16 # will parse strikethrough from ~~, for example: ~~bad~~ 17 strikethrough: true, 18 # will parse superscript after ^, you can wrap superscript in () 19 superscript: true 20 # will require a space after # in defining headers 21 # space_after_headers: true 22 } 23 Redcarpet::Markdown.
